```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "center", fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_bw() + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(source(here::here("R/load_all.R")))
```

The finalists on both diseases and both bases (the submitted ensemble and the clean `windowed_seasonal` replay). E10 runs them; E07 compares the two flu bases before and after calibration. Each section is a self-contained experiment with its own runs;
the ids match `notes/calibration-ledger.md`.

```{r e10, results="asis"}
cal_section("_e10_flu_covid.Rmd", list(workers = params$workers))
```

```{r e07, results="asis"}

```
